description: This file contains implementation of functions related to timed wait operations using POSIX threads, including initialization of condition variables with support for monotonic clocks, and performing timed waits with millisecond and nanosecond granularity, primarily for use in synchronization mechanisms within concurrent programming.

methods.name: int initTimedWaitCond(pthread_cond_t * cond)
methods.description: Initializes a pthread condition variable with attributes that enable support for monotonic clocks if available, facilitating relative timed waits.

methods.name: int doCondTimedWait(pthread_cond_t * cond,pthread_mutex_t * mtx,struct timespec * tp)
methods.description: Performs the actual pthread condition variable timed wait, choosing the appropriate system call based on platform and support for monotonic clocks.

methods.name: int incrementalCondTimedWait(pthread_cond_t * cond,pthread_mutex_t * mtx,int timeoutSecs)
methods.description: Performs a timed wait on a condition variable for a specified number of seconds, utilizing monotonic clocks if supported.

methods.name: int incrementalCondTimedWaitMillis(pthread_cond_t * cond,pthread_mutex_t * mtx,uint64_t timeoutMillis)
methods.description: Performs a timed wait on a condition variable for a specified number of milliseconds, utilizing monotonic clocks if supported.

methods.name: int granularIncrementalCondTimedWait(pthread_cond_t * cond,pthread_mutex_t * mtx,struct timespec * waitTime)
methods.description: Performs a highly granular timed wait on a condition variable with nanosecond precision, supporting relative wait times.
